clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, Tharek Blackstone keeps dwarven tools flowing to local craftsmen. Beldin Steelgrill at Steelgrill's Depot is his main customer, and Tharek also helps travelers find work around town.

Tharek Blackstone keeps his forge busy in Kharanos, repairing gear and making tools for local workers. His main customer is Beldin Steelgrill, whose mechanostrider depot just outside town needs a steady supply of heavy wrenches, gears, and replacement tools. Tharek hires passing travelers to carry finished crates to the depot, so he can keep up with the work at his forge.

Tharek has earned the respect of people across Dun Morogh through his work at the anvil. He holds no formal military title, but people in town turn to him for odd jobs, supply runs, and help coordinating local efforts.
